registered: round 74, 2026-10-26, BEFORE the first model call of batch v3
question: In the live system (real model channel, `vacant run` gate), does arm B (retry=resample, max-attempts=3, restart driven by the visible suite) accept more runs than arm A (retry=none), on the 6 polyglot_py tasks?
why_this_row: For polyglot_py the visible tests ARE the grader (test text is in the prompt; suite runs the same test class), so resample-on-visible-failure is the valid real-signal row, NOT the upper-bound scorer row. Offline replay of this same row (round 67, ref/offline_restart_sim.py over ref/c37_final.json): polyglot_py 37.3 -> 47.0% (+9.7pp, n=68 units with >=2 independent runs; ALL 62.3 -> 66.4%, +4.1pp, n=331). This batch is the live-system confirmation attempt for that row.

fixed.rep_definition: one full 6-task x 2-arm grid in a fresh root (runs_v3_r{k}); each run is a fresh process, fresh workspace, no shared state; reps are independent

outcome: per-run summary.accepted (visible suite passed). Refusals count as failures (in the denominator). infra_void runs (model channel failed) are dropped from denominators and reported separately; never back-filled.

analysis.primary_unit: (task, rep) pair; n_pairs = 18; n_runs per arm = 18 (36 total)
analysis.primary_statistic: exact two-sided McNemar on discordant pairs via vacant_network.research.mcnemar_exact(b, c); b = (A pass, B fail), c = (A fail, B pass)
analysis.per_rep: descriptive: (b, c, p) per rep; same direction across all 3 reps with none passing correction is UNRESOLVED, not negative, not positive
not_done: no pooling of v1/v2 into v3 (separate unregistered batches)
no pooling of independent batches into one manufactured n
no hidden-suite/scorer signal enters the arm decision (round 67 guard test pins this)

decision_states.EFFECTIVE: c > b AND p < 0.05 -> may state: B accepted more than A on this batch (n=18 pairs, 6 tasks x 3 reps), direction-consistent with the offline real-signal row (polyglot_py +9.7pp, n=68). May NOT state 'proves better' (one batch, one model, small n, H-12).
decision_states.CONTRADICTS: c < b AND p < 0.05 -> no effect claim in EITHER direction; investigate. 'the loop is harmful' is NOT a pre-registered conclusion (R532 AMEND1 direction guard: a significant result in the opposite direction has no pre-registered state and draws no harm conclusion).
decision_states.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (including c > b with p >= 0.05) -> record direction and magnitude only; a null here is not a negative result (n=18 is underpowered to detect +9.7pp).
decision_states.INCOMPLETE: round budget ended before rep 3 finished -> only completed reps reported descriptively; no decision state assigned; partial batch is neither clean nor dirty.

known_caveats: n=18 pairs is underpowered for a +9.7pp effect; UNRESOLVED is the expected-common outcome and is a legitimate state
single model, single slot, 6 tasks: does not transfer to another model/harness/budget/corpus without re-running (H-12)
v1 (3/6 vs 2/6) and v2 (4/6 vs 4/6) remain unregistered smoke evidence; this prereg does not retroactively cover them
